home.status.vpnLocked: Locked until VPN is set up

service.recyclarr: Keeps quality settings up to date

wizard.welcome.title: Welcome to EasyArr
wizard.welcome.intro: EasyArr turns your Umbrel into your own streaming service. It sets up and connects a dozen media apps for you — no terminal, no config files. This setup takes about 10 minutes.
wizard.welcome.flow.request: You ask for a movie, show or album
wizard.welcome.flow.download: EasyArr finds and downloads it, always through a VPN
wizard.welcome.flow.sort: It's renamed, sorted and gets posters and subtitles
wizard.welcome.flow.watch: You watch it on your TV, phone or browser
wizard.welcome.legal: Only download content you have the right to download and share. Laws differ between countries — you are responsible for following the laws where you live.
wizard.welcome.restoreSoon: Restoring from a backup arrives in a later update.
wizard.system.title: Checking your Umbrel
wizard.system.intro: EasyArr runs many apps at once. Here's how well your Umbrel is suited.
wizard.account.title: Create your account
wizard.account.intro: This is the login you'll use to watch (Jellyfin) and to request new things (Jellyseerr).
wizard.download.title: How do you want to download?
wizard.download.intro: There are two ways to get movies and shows. Not sure? Start with torrents — you can change this later.
wizard.error.loadFailed: EasyArr couldn't load your setup progress. Check that the app is running, then try again.
wizard.error.saveFailed: Saving didn't work. Please try again.
wizard.error.network: EasyArr can't be reached right now. Check your connection to the Umbrel and try again.
wizard.error.previousSteps: Please finish the earlier steps first.
wizard.error.usernameInvalid: Use 2–32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or number.
wizard.error.passwordWeak: This password is too easy to guess. Try a few random words, e.g. “purple-train-river”.
wizard.error.acknowledgeRequired: Please confirm that you want to continue anyway.
wizard.error.downloadMethodRequired: Please choose one of the options.
system.failed: The check didn't work. Try again in a moment.
system.summary.ok: Your Umbrel is ready for EasyArr.
system.summary.warning: EasyArr will work. Read the notes below.
system.summary.error: Your Umbrel may struggle to run EasyArr.
system.acknowledge: I understand that EasyArr may be slow or unstable on this Umbrel, and want to continue anyway.
system.arch.title: Processor
system.arch.unsupported: {{arch}} isn't supported. EasyArr's apps only exist for amd64 and arm64.
system.memory.title: Memory (RAM)
system.memory.low: {{gb}} GB — works, but your other Umbrel apps may get slower. 8 GB or more is best.
system.memory.tooLow: {{gb}} GB — not enough. EasyArr needs at least 4 GB, apps may crash or stall.
system.disk.title: Free space
system.disk.low: Only {{free}} free. Movies and shows are big — downloads stop when the disk is full.
system.disk.unknown: EasyArr couldn't read the free space. You can continue; keep an eye on it in Umbrel's settings.
system.gpu.title: Graphics (for video conversion)
system.gpu.dri: Found a graphics chip. Jellyfin can use it to convert videos quickly.
system.gpu.nvidia: Found an NVIDIA graphics card. Jellyfin can use it to convert videos quickly.
system.gpu.none: No graphics chip found. Jellyfin works, but converting high-quality video for some devices will be slow.
account.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores.
account.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. A few random words are easy to remember and hard to guess.
account.passwordKeep: A password is already saved. Leave both fields empty to keep it.
account.usedFor: You'll log in with this account in Jellyfin (watching) and Jellyseerr (requesting). The other apps are protected by your Umbrel login.
account.family: Accounts for family and friends are added later, once the setup is finished.
password.hint.common: this is a very common password
password.hint.variety: add numbers, capitals or symbols — or more words
download.changeLater: You can change this later in Settings.
download.torrents.title: Torrents
download.torrents.summary: Download from other people who share the same file.
download.torrents.con1: Speed depends on how many people share
download.torrents.con2: Needs a VPN (EasyArr sets it up next)
download.usenet.title: Usenet
download.usenet.summary: Download from paid servers, like from a normal website.
download.usenet.pro2: You don't share anything with others
download.usenet.con1: Costs a few euros/dollars a month
download.usenet.con2: Needs two accounts: a provider and an indexer
download.both.title: Both
download.both.summary: Use torrents and Usenet together and get whichever has it.
docs.title: Help
wizard.vpn.title: Protect your downloads with a VPN
wizard.vpn.intro: Downloads go through a VPN so your internet provider and other people only see the VPN, never your home address. Pick your VPN, follow the short guide, then press Connect.
wizard.vpn.skipNote: Not ready yet? You can skip this and add a VPN later in Settings — but until then, downloading stays switched off.
wizard.vpn.skipBody: EasyArr never downloads without a VPN. Until you connect one, Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr and the download apps can't reach the internet, so nothing will download. Jellyfin and everything you already have keep working. Nothing leaks — downloads are blocked, not sent unprotected.
wizard.vpn.skipConfirm: Skip — I'll set it up later
wizard.error.vpnNotTested: Connect and pass the connection test first, or skip this step.
vpn.picker.noMatch: No provider matches. If yours isn't listed, use "Custom" with a WireGuard or OpenVPN file from your provider.
vpn.group.recommended.title: Best for torrents
vpn.group.recommended.body: These support port forwarding, which makes torrents faster and more reliable.
vpn.group.works.title: Also works
vpn.group.works.body: Safe and fine for Usenet; torrents work too, just slower without port forwarding.
vpn.group.custom.title: Custom
vpn.group.custom.body: Use a WireGuard (.conf) or OpenVPN (.ovpn) file from any provider.
vpn.protocol.label: Connection type
vpn.connecting.title: Connecting…
vpn.connecting.tunnel: Talking to your VPN provider. This usually takes under 30 seconds. ({{seconds}} s)
vpn.field.saved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it, or paste a new one.
vpn.field.wgPrivateKey.label: WireGuard private key
vpn.field.wgPrivateKey.hint: 44 characters ending in "=". The guide shows where to find it.
vpn.field.wgPresharedKey.label: WireGuard preshared key
vpn.field.wgPresharedKey.hint: Only if your WireGuard file has a "PresharedKey" line.
vpn.field.wgAddresses.label: WireGuard address
vpn.field.wgAddresses.hint: The "Address" line from your WireGuard file, e.g. 10.64.222.21/32.
vpn.field.username.label: VPN username
vpn.field.username.hint: The OpenVPN / service username from the guide — often not your website login.
vpn.field.password.label: VPN password
vpn.field.password.hint: The OpenVPN / service password from the guide.
vpn.field.clientCert.label: Client certificate
vpn.field.clientCert.hint: Paste the text between <cert> and </cert> from your .ovpn file.
vpn.field.clientKey.label: Client key
vpn.field.clientKey.hint: Paste the text between <key> and </key> from your .ovpn file.
vpn.field.encryptedKey.label: Encrypted client key
vpn.field.encryptedKey.hint: The encrypted key block from your .ovpn file.
vpn.field.keyPassphrase.label: Key passphrase
vpn.field.keyPassphrase.hint: The passphrase that unlocks the encrypted key.
vpn.field.wgConfig.label: WireGuard file (.conf)
vpn.field.wgConfig.hint: Paste the whole file or choose it below. It needs [Interface] and [Peer] sections.
vpn.field.ovpnConfig.label: OpenVPN file (.ovpn)
vpn.field.ovpnConfig.hint: Paste the whole file or choose it below.
vpn.freePlan.label: I use the free plan
vpn.freePlan.hint: Only free servers will be used. Free plans have no port forwarding.
vpn.pf.label: Port forwarding
vpn.pf.autoHint: Recommended for torrents. EasyArr asks your VPN for a port and sets it in qBittorrent automatically.
vpn.pf.staticHint: Reserve a port in your VPN account (see the guide) and enter it here. EasyArr sets it in qBittorrent.
vpn.result.homeUnknown: Couldn't double-check your home IP right now (that check needs the internet outside the VPN). The VPN itself is connected.
vpn.result.pfOff: Port forwarding is off — torrents work, just slower
vpn.result.pfWaiting: Waiting for your VPN to hand out a port…
vpn.problem.wrongKey.title: The key isn't right
vpn.problem.wrongKey.fix: The WireGuard key wasn't accepted. Copy it again from your VPN account — the whole key, with the "=" at the end and no spaces.
vpn.problem.authFailed.title: Username or password was refused
vpn.problem.authFailed.fix: Your VPN said no to the login. Most providers use special VPN credentials, not your website login — the guide shows where to find them. Also check your subscription is active.
vpn.problem.noServer.title: No server matches your choice
vpn.problem.noServer.fix: There's no server for this location with these options. Choose "Fastest / any", another location, or turn off port forwarding.
vpn.problem.invalidSettings.title: Something in the settings is missing or wrong
vpn.problem.invalidSettings.fix: Check every field against the guide and try again. The technical details below say which setting.
vpn.problem.certificate.title: The certificate or key wasn't accepted
vpn.problem.certificate.fix: Download a fresh config file from your VPN account and paste it again.
vpn.problem.unreachable.title: Couldn't reach the VPN server
vpn.problem.unreachable.fix: Your settings were accepted, but no connection came up. Try another location, or check your subscription. With WireGuard, a wrong key often looks like this too — copy it again.
vpn.problem.system.title: The VPN can't start on this device
vpn.problem.system.fix: The VPN part of EasyArr is missing a permission. Restart EasyArr from the Umbrel home screen; if it keeps happening, please report it.
vpn.problem.controlServer.title: The VPN isn't answering
vpn.problem.controlServer.fix: The VPN part of EasyArr started but doesn't answer. Press Test again in a minute, or restart EasyArr.
vpn.problem.vpnContainer.title: The VPN part of EasyArr isn't running
vpn.problem.vpnContainer.fix: Restart EasyArr from the Umbrel home screen (right-click → Restart) and try again.
vpn.problem.homeIpVisible.title: Your home IP is NOT hidden
vpn.problem.homeIpVisible.fix: The connection shows your real home address, so it is not protecting you. Check you picked the right provider and settings. Downloads stay blocked until this passes.
vpn.problem.unknown.title: The VPN didn't connect
vpn.problem.unknown.fix: Check your settings against the guide and try again. The technical details below may help.
vpn.error.load: Couldn't load your VPN settings. Reload the page to try again.
vpn.error.test: The connection test didn't finish. Check that EasyArr is running and try again.
vpn.error.invalidCharacters: This contains characters that can't be right — paste it again.
vpn.error.invalidCertificate: This doesn't look like a certificate or key. Copy the whole block again.
vpn.error.wgKey: A WireGuard key is 44 characters and ends with "=". Copy it again.
vpn.error.wgConfig: This doesn't look like a complete WireGuard file (it needs PrivateKey, Address, PublicKey and Endpoint).
vpn.error.ovpnConfig: This doesn't look like an OpenVPN file (no "remote" line).
vpn.error.endpointResolve: The server name in your file couldn't be found. Check your internet connection or use a file with an IP address.
vpn.error.location: Pick a location from the list.
vpn.error.freePlan: This provider has no free plan.
vpn.error.portForwarding: This provider has no port forwarding.
vpn.error.portForwardingFree: Free plans have no port forwarding.
vpn.error.provider: Pick a provider from the list.
vpn.error.protocol: This provider doesn't support that connection type.
